name: Yurihama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yurihama town emblem in green and blue: a three-armed swirl of green and blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yurihama, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 June 2005.

features.role: Yurihama town emblem — a three-armed swirl of green and blue curved strokes
